Subject: Extra workbench help for your bike

Cyclists looking to keep older parts rolling can bring bicycle wheels to the repair cafe on June 3. Our volunteer mechanics will be ready to check tension and straighten rims during the session. Since space fills quickly, guests must book a slot ahead of arrival to guarantee a turn.
